evidence.reason: The sibling `moved` is enqueued at `AT` (2026-10-30T00:00:00Z) but checked on 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z, 11 days later. Because `eligible()` applies the 24-hour age guard before reading family quarantine history, line 130 is false for staleness and would still be false if the shared-quarantine check were removed. The test therefore does not verify the behavior named by this assertion. Enqueuing the sibling near the sixth failure and checking at the 24-hour boundary would make the assertion exercise the family quarantine.
